welcome.title: Welcome to Guide Studio
welcome.description: Here's a 30-second tour of the editor. You can replay it any time from the help button up top.

toolRail.title: Your toolbox
toolRail.description: Every editing tool lives here — backgrounds, effects, layout, cursor, and crop. Click an icon to open its panel.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.description: See your guide render exactly as it will export, updating live as you make changes.

timeline.title: The timeline
timeline.description: Trim, split, and reorder clips, add zooms, and fine-tune captions along the track.

ai.title: AI superpowers
ai.description: One click for auto-polish, captions, and AI voiceover — or chat with the editor to make edits for you.

export.title: Export & publish
export.description: When you're happy, export to MP4 or GIF, or publish your guide as a shareable kit.
